title: An Aries in a meeting that could’ve been an email.
old_caption:
Volunteered first, started three projects, finished none?
Aries learns the trick: pick one and finish it.

title: What a Cancer feels at 3 AM: everything.
old_caption:
Awake at 3 AM feeling every feeling at once?
The Moon changes every night and is still the Moon. Moods have phases, and so do you.

title: POV: a Cancer checks on everyone before 8 AM.
old_caption:
Texting good morning to everyone and forgetting breakfast?
Cancer sends twelve check-ins before 8 AM, then remembers one more person: itself.

title: A Cancer's home is everyone's home.
old_caption:
Got a friend whose couch is everyone's safe place?
Cancer builds a blanket fort for the whole crew, because home is who, not where.

title: A Cancer remembers what you said in 2019.
old_caption:
Did someone ever remember a tiny thing you said years ago?
That is how a Cancer says I love you: with homemade crackers.

title: A Cancer is the office mom.
old_caption:
Are you the one who remembers every birthday at work?
Cancer's care keeps the office going. Care is real work, so let others give some back.

title: A Capricorn at 3 AM: am I enough if I stop?
old_caption:
Up at 3 AM wondering if you are still worth it when you rest?
Capricorn logs off on purpose. You are enough off the clock.

title: POV: a Capricorn's morning started yesterday.
old_caption:
Up before your alarm with a to-do list already running?
Capricorn's morning sheet is missing one row until Saturn points it out. Rest is part of the plan.

title: Capricorn: the friend who's basically a parent.
old_caption:
Are you the friend who always has snacks, band-aids and water?
Capricorn, let your people carry the bags for once.

title: A Capricorn schedules a date… in a spreadsheet.
old_caption:
Would you plan date night down to the minute?
Capricorn makes a spreadsheet, Cancer adds one surprise row. Schedule the fun, then leave room for it.
